note: Which art each problem type 0-33 draws from: a number below 900 is the bundle bNNN of inventory.json's problem_art_index (its pictures in id order, the first is the panel; the type's art_keys are their problem_art keys), a number of 1000 and up is the one loose picture with that id (problem_art/pa_<number> or its name). Committed so that the dev generator needs no importer output (extracted/ is not committed). Two types may share a bundle.
